title: Emission of a single site bit
statement: Fix a Boolean parameter $\ell$, natural numbers $n,i,B$, an oracle assigning a Boolean answer to each of five deciders and each bit string, and a site $s$. Let $k,V,U,W$ be natural numbers with $k\le i$, $k+1\le B$, and $V,U,W\le B$. Starting from the configuration with control state $\mathrm{em}(s)$, registers $(k,V,U,W)$, and no answer, the one-term segment consisting of the bit assigned to $s$ satisfies the emission property, with postcondition that the resulting configuration has control state $s$'s successor, registers $(k+1,V,U,W)$, and no answer.
